Caroline: quick FYI — ran the int4 bring-up for shadowrun-13b on canary. initial microbench shows ~48% token cost reduction but some drop on long-form summarization.
Ajay: can you paste the slice perf numbers?
Caroline: core numbers: int8 p99 latency 180ms, int4 p99 210ms; cost/token int8 $0.0042, int4 $0.0023; rouge-L drop ~1.8 pts on longform (5k+ tokens)
Dmitri: yikes on the rouge drop. is it prompt-specific or priming drift?
Caroline: looks priming-related. small prompts (<=512) match, larger contexts diverge. KV cache evictions higher with our hybrid kernel.
Maria: any logs/error traces?
Caroline: pasted run excerpt:
```
2026-03-12T21:14:03Z model=shadowrun-13b quant=int4 slice=longform eval/rouge-L=67.2 -> 65.4
kv_cache/evictions=340 per_min
batch_size=1
```
Ajay: can we try warming KV cache + increase prefix-caching TTL? expected to help.
Dmitri: +1; also try fallback routing for >2k tokens to int8. cost delta for fallback is +0.007 cents/token vs baseline but avoids quality loss.
Maria: for product/GTN note: unit econ calc if we route 20% longform -> int8: overall cost reduction becomes ~40% instead of 48% but quality preserved.
Caroline: OK I'll run a scan overnight: TTL=60s, fallback rule threshold=2048 tokens. Will post results tomorrow.
ops-bot: Deploy job shadowrun-int4-warmup started (#3412) :gear: 
Ajay: thanks — if that fixes rouge by >1pt we're green to start canary 10% traffic.
Caroline: agreed. will update with numbers + concise scorecard (latency/cost/rouge) once done :white_check_mark:
